name: WeBuyCars
verdict: The brand of JSE-listed We Buy Cars Holdings; its largest disclosed shareholder is the Public Investment Corporation, South Africa's state pension-fund manager, with 15.775%. Nothing found.
note: Southern Guards GC team partner 2026 (livgolf.com/southern-guards-gc, opened 2026-10-03). Listed on the JSE (WBC) in April 2024 after Transaction Capital's unbundling; Transaction Capital no longer holds shares. Disclosed major holders: PIC 15.775%, Coronation 14.87%, I VDW Holdings 5.65%, Allan Gray 5.16%, Camissa 5.05% (sashares.co.za, from SENS beneficial-interest notices, opened 2026-10-03). South Africa is not a state with a sourced record under METHOD.md, so the PIC stake does not rate; the rest are private asset managers or a family vehicle.
